links.outcome: Turkish readability level of AI-generated hip replacement discharge education material
links.effect: Turkish readability index was 69.5, rated "easily understandable".
links.quote: It was concluded that the readability index of the total hip replacement discharge education material for Turkish was 69.5, and the Turkish readability level was "easily understandable".

links.outcome: Expert-rated understandability and actionability of AI-generated patient education material (PEMAT)
links.effect: PEMAT understandability 80.60 ± 9.74; actionability 77.4 ± 19.10; GQS 4.20 ± 0.79; inter-expert consistency 0.84.
links.quote: It was determined that the Patient Education Materials Evaluation Tool understandability score average was 80.60 ± 9.74, and the actionability score average was 77.4 ± 19.10.

screen.reason: The study develops Turkish discharge education materials for total hip replacement patients using ChatGPT-4 and evaluates their readability and quality via expert ratings (PEMAT, GQS) without evaluating a specific operational deployment practice.
